mapper.select: SELECT * FROM ocean_gis.gis_file_group WHERE id=#{id} AND deleted=0 FOR UPDATE
SELECT * FROM ocean_gis.gis_file_group WHERE data_set_id=#{dataSetId} AND deleted=0 ORDER BY id FOR UPDATE
SELECT * FROM ocean_gis.gis_file_meta WHERE ingest_progress_id=#{progressId} AND deleted=0 ORDER BY data_set_id,id
SELECT * FROM ocean_gis.gis_file_meta WHERE file_group_id=#{groupId} AND deleted=0 ORDER BY member_path,id
SELECT * FROM ocean_gis.gis_file_group WHERE data_set_id=#{dataSetId} AND fingerprint=#{fingerprint} AND deleted=0
mapper.update: UPDATE ocean_gis.gis_file_meta SET file_group_id=#{groupId},member_path=#{path},ingest_outcome=#{outcome}, update_time=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id=#{id} AND deleted=0 AND file_group_id IS NULL
UPDATE ocean_gis.gis_file_meta SET ingest_outcome=#{outcome},update_time=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE file_group_id=#{groupId} AND ingest_progress_id=#{progressId} AND deleted=0

UPDATE ocean_gis.gis_file_meta SET metadata_status='PARKED',metadata_lease_expires_at=NULL, metadata_version=metadata_version+1,metadata_error_code=#{code},metadata_error_message=#{message}, representative_longitude=NULL,representative_latitude=NULL,representative_layer_key=NULL, representative_extent_kind=NULL,metadata_extracted_at=NULL,update_time=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id=#{id} AND deleted=0 AND metadata_status IN ('WAITING','QUEUED','RUNNING','PARKED','FAILED')

UPDATE ocean_gis.gis_file_meta SET metadata_status='QUEUED',metadata_lease_expires_at=NULL, metadata_version=metadata_version+1,metadata_error_code=NULL,metadata_error_message=NULL, representative_longitude=NULL,representative_latitude=NULL,representative_layer_key=NULL, representative_extent_kind=NULL,metadata_extracted_at=NULL,update_time=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id=#{id} AND deleted=0 AND file_status='READY'
UPDATE ocean_gis.gis_file_meta SET sha256=#{sha256} WHERE id=#{id} AND deleted=0 AND sha256 IS NULL

UPDATE ocean_gis.gis_file_group SET name=#{group.name},format=#{group.format},entry_file_id=#{group.entryFileId}, assembly_status=#{group.assemblyStatus},parse_status=#{group.parseStatus},input_revision=#{group.inputRevision}, fingerprint=#{group.fingerprint},duplicate_of_group_id=#{group.duplicateOfGroupId},matched_revision=#{group.matchedRevision}, read_options_json=#{group.readOptionsJson},error_code=#{group.errorCode},error_message=#{group.errorMessage}, update_time=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id=#{group.id} AND deleted=0
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM ocean_gis.gis_file_group WHERE id=#{id} AND deleted=0
